item.title: Customer Complaints Always Arrive On Time
item.description: Read Customer Complaints Always Arrive On Time Customer: "I wanted my food fresh! Fresh! That's why I ordered and set the time! You finished the food too early! You need to remake it!" Me: "We're not doing that, ma'am. You selected 7:15 PM, it was ready at 7:15 PM." Read Customer Complaints Always Arrive On Time

item.title: A Moose-t Have Dessert
item.description: Read A Moose-t Have Dessert We often would go there for dinner at least once per visit to my grandmother. On one such occasion, we were ordering dessert, and I chose chocolate mousse, as that was definitely not something I could get at home. Read A Moose-t Have Dessert
